text:
Tess: Tiny office emergency: our philodendron (aka Sir Photos-a-Lot) entered the building and is now leaning dramatically toward the window. suggestions? :herb:
Omar: Rotate it 90 degrees and whisper 'grow' while pretending you're in a gardening montage. :seedling: :muscle:
Grace: Or feed it coffee grounds. plants love free caffeine. maybe not. consults plant handbook™. :coffee:
Hector: My only skill is watering with reckless optimism. I'll volunteer for tilt duty. :raised_hand:
Nina: PSA: someone used my salad container from the shared fridge. if you accidentally ate it, please replace. I forgive but expect artisanal compensation. :salad:
Tess: saga: salad thief + leaning plant = a dramatic Monday. we should have a confession jar. :money_with_wings:
Omar: Also shoutout to @Grace for rescuing the deploy last night. massive help. :clap:
kudos-bot: New kudos! Grace received a kudos from Omar: "Saved the deploy -> Team MVP". :trophy: (system)
Hector: Quick poll: team lunch tomorrow 9: pizza, sushi, or build-your-own bowls? vote now so I don't choose wrong. ```/poll "Team lunch" "Pizza" "Sushi" "Bowls"```
ops-bot: Poll created by Hector. Vote using the buttons in thread. (system)
Grace: also tiny contest: best office plant name wins a coffee. submit names. I'll judge. :coffee:
Nina: Sir Photos-a-Lot is a contender but I nominate "Photosynthesis Pete". :joy:
Tess: I like "Leaf Erickson". punny and nautical. :sailboat:
Omar: "Fernie Sanders" for political foliage energy. :laughing:
Hector: Reminder: please label your food. the salad thief will be exposed. justice for salads. :eyes:
ops-bot: Building note: mailroom open 9-5. Badge readers tested earlier today, no issues. (system)
